intended_behavior: Refactor this method to support pluggable or configurable LLM clients including custom clients that authenticate via JWT tokens. It should conditionally call litellm.completion if the default API key based client is used, otherwise delegate to the custom client. This change enables flexible authentication while preserving existing litellm usage.

Similarly, this method should be refactored to allow selection between litellm.completion and alternative custom client invocations that support JWT authentication. This supports the feature request to provide custom LLM support without breaking existing functionality.
